newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak cbank repo average yield rises to 18.78 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak cbank repo average yield rises to 18.78 pct.

text.p: Average yield in a Slovak central bank (NBS) three-day repo tender on Friday rose to 18.78 percent from 18.60 percent on Thursday, the NBS said in a statement.
The central bank offered a fixed volume of 3.5 billion crowns. Overall bids totalled 6.925 billion crowns.
The maximum accepted yield hit 19.20 percent while the minimum yield was 18.00 percent.
The NBS added one billion crowns to the local money market through a one-day repo tender on Thursday at an average yield of 18.60 percent, up from 17.62 percent in a similar repo on Wednesday.
The NBS monitors market liquidity on a daily basis and decides each morning whether to hold any open market operations.
According to NBS figures, the Slovak banking sector as of July 10 lacked some 0.94 percent of the funds needed to meet minimum reserves requirements on July 15.
